recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-5240 unless a later work group decision revises the extensibility guidance more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-5240 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 technical correction for FHIR-core extensibility wording. It asked to fix a confusing sentence so it referred to human decisions being made around how data in extensions should be handled and the implicit obligations surrounding that information.
initial_application: The correction was applied in SVN r4194, mirrored as git commit b96ed091e1a76a841b2ad40c8f31486489d18881, which changed source/extensibility.html from the malformed text about 'data extensions contain' and obligations 'that around' the information to the requested corrected wording.
additional_context: The page remains current build-scope narrative: source/fhir.ini maps the Extension type page to extensibility and source/documentation.html links extensibility.html from the framework documentation index. Later commit bc32512f59b1d2696fbe6e89a6985b7840c4e924 changed 'required to be made around' to 'required to determine' while preserving the corrected data-in-extensions and surrounding-obligations meaning. Searches found no relevant Zulip or Confluence discussion altering that conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already says applications generally need human decisions to determine how the data in extensions should be handled, along with implicit obligations that surround the information.
